POP (Plaster of Paris) is custom-made on-site, can be crafted to create intricate details and designs, and fits perfectly for decorative lighting. POP offers a premium and luxurious look, making it ideal for bigger homes and villas. Although installing it can be a time-consuming and messy process.

Gypsum, the ready-made boards, on the other hand, offer a hassle-free and quick installation while creating a smooth and seamless finish. The final answer is - for big homes where customization and a premium look are concerns, opt for POP, and for modern compact homes where quick installation is required, go for Gypsum.
